title: QUIZ - 08
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Apply fraction addition to a two-day consumption word problem
questions.question: On Monday, a family used \( \frac{1}{2} \) of a bag of rice. On Tuesday, they used \( \frac{1}{6} \) more. What fraction of the bag of rice did they use in total over the two days?
questions.explanation: Adding the two fractions requires a common denominator of 12: \( \frac{1}{2} \) + \( \frac{1}{6} \) = \( \frac{2}{3} \).
questions.hint: Add the two fractional amounts using a common denominator.

questions.learningObjective: Combine three fractions with different denominators using addition and subtraction
questions.question: Evaluate: \( 1/3 + 3/4 + 1/8 \)
questions.explanation: Convert every fraction to a common denominator, then add or subtract the numerators from left to right in order. Carrying out this process for \( 1/3 + 3/4 + 1/8 \) gives \( \frac{29}{24} \).
questions.hint: Convert all fractions to a common denominator, then combine them left to right.

questions.concept: Adding and Subtracting Fractions with Like Denominators
questions.learningObjective: Add or subtract fractions that share a common denominator
questions.question: Calculate: \( 1/6 + 2/6 \)
questions.explanation: Since the denominators are the same, add the numerators and keep the denominator: 1 + 2 = 3 over 6, which simplifies to \( \frac{1}{2} \).
questions.hint: When denominators match, only add or subtract the numerators.

questions.concept: Adding and Subtracting Fractions with Like Denominators
questions.learningObjective: Add or subtract fractions that share a common denominator
questions.question: Calculate: \( 1/9 - 1/9 \)
questions.explanation: Since the denominators are the same, subtract the numerators and keep the denominator: 1 - 1 = 0 over 9, which simplifies to \( 0 \).
questions.hint: When denominators match, only add or subtract the numerators.

questions.concept: Adding and Subtracting Fractions with Like Denominators
questions.learningObjective: Add or subtract fractions that share a common denominator

questions.explanation: Since the denominators are the same, subtract the numerators and keep the denominator: 3 - 4 = -1 over 9, which simplifies to \( -\frac{1}{9} \).

questions.concept: Adding and Subtracting Fractions with Unlike Denominators
questions.learningObjective: Find a common denominator to add or subtract fractions with different denominators

questions.explanation: Rewrite with a common denominator of 30: \( \frac{3}{5} \) - \( \frac{1}{3} \). Combining the numerators gives \( \frac{4}{15} \).
